title: Remunerate
summary: REMU'NERATE, verb transitive [Latin remunero; re and munero, from munus, a gift.] to reward; to recompense; to requite; in a good sense; to pay an equivalent to for any service, loss, expense or other

inlines.v: REMU'NERATE, verb transitive [Latin remunero; re and munero, from munus, a gift.] to reward; to recompense; to requite; in a good sense; to pay an equivalent to for any service, loss, expense or other sacrifice; as, to remunerate the troops of an army for their services and sufferings; to remunerate men for labor. the pious usfferer in this life will be remunerated in the life to come.
